Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented UID-0 backdoor account (dg) with a firmware-wide default password (ivanlee) and interactive shell (/bin/ash), allowing authentication as root via SSH or local console without device-specific secrets. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the account from the shipped root filesystem and disables root password authentication in SSH. Users can update their router can be through the local web interface. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability in the LuCI white_list RPC handler (/usr/lib/lua/luci/data/white_list_plt.lua), where unsanitized user-supplied MAC addresses are concatenated into os.execute() without validation, yielding root command execution via a malformed mac parameter. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and users can update their router through the local web interface. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented telnet backdoor daemon (/usr/bin/telnetd_startup) that, upon receipt of a precomputed AES-128-CBC magic packet using a firmware-wide static key and IV, enables telnet service with default credentials, providing remote root access. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the UDP listener entirely, and users can update through their local web interface. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in /usr/bin/cloud_manage, where a server-controlled JSON diagnoseParameter field is passed unsanitized to popen(), enabling arbitrary command execution as root over cleartext HTTP when an attacker is positioned on-path and has access to the hard-coded cloud endpoint. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and your router can be updated through the local web interface. 11/11/2026 11/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PropertyGrid does not encode bound property values and items[].description in its default configuration. An attacker who can influence either value can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the grid. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PivotGrid and PivotConfigurator axis field names are passed to a chip template without appropriate encoding. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context.
